title: A Lewis acid–base reaction
caption: Ammonia's lone pair is donated to boron trifluoride, whose boron has only six outer electrons and an empty orbital. NH₃ is the Lewis base (electron-pair donor) and BF₃ the Lewis acid (acceptor); the product has a coordinate bond.
alt: Ammonia approaching boron trifluoride with a curly arrow from nitrogen's lone pair to boron, then the adduct H₃N⁺–B⁻F₃.
description: NH₃ on the left with a lone pair on nitrogen; planar BF₃ on the right.
A curly arrow from the nitrogen lone pair to the boron.
Product: H₃N–BF₃, nitrogen +1 and boron −1 formally, joined by a coordinate bond.
